common.organization: A business organization, distinct from its login accounts and people.
common.account: An application login identity; not proof of one natural person.
common.person: A natural person. No person-to-account identity is inferred from the supplied evidence.
common.asset: A physical asset, whose identity is distinct from source records describing it.
common.case: A recorded service or complaint case.
common.document: A business document or report with its own lifecycle.
common.event: A dated activity, visit or historical event.
common.item: A part, stock item or configuration reference.
common.measurement: A quantity with a defined or explicitly unresolved unit and calculation.

manufacturer: Equipment maker buying engines; distinct from a login account or current engine owner.
service_case: A complaint case concerning a submitted engine serial.
service_account: An account participating in service processes; person or shared-account interpretation is unresolved.
service_document: A report, request, work-order document or service guidance record.
service_event: An inspection, training, assignment or service-history event.
engine_reference: A physical engine reference; serial-to-physical-identity resolution requires evidence.
invoice: A billing record, not proof of current ownership.
claim_line: A claim line concerning an engine and part; source reconciliation is separate.
stock_item: An individually represented stock engine or part reference.
inventory_summary: A periodic stock count/cost summary with source and unit provenance.
configuration: A model/list configuration reference whose uniqueness and detailed business meaning need review.
role_set: A set of staff application role flags, not a login account.
identifier_reference: A lookup identifier whose relationship to physical assets requires validation.
controlled_code: A typed application code reference, distinct from an engine configuration.
training_measure: An entered training target/actual measure with unresolved formula or units.
report_measure: A reporting measure whose authority and calculation require validation.
sales_measure: A sales reporting source or measure, not automatically authoritative.

oem_company: Equipment manufacturer in the company-name master. Company name is unique in the saved index; this is not a login account.
oem_account: Email login under an OEM company. Personal, shared plant and branch meanings are not distinguished by the application.
staff_account: Staff login with roles from limits. A matching email in an OEM login does not establish identity equivalence.
role_flags: Boolean roles for a staff account, not monetary or workload limits and not final ontology access policy.
engine: Physical engine as a business concept. Neither a serial-only lookup nor one invoice row guarantees globally resolved physical identity.
engine_invoice: Invoice-master entry keyed by billed-to OEM company and engine serial. Billed-to company is not established current ownership; serial-first-match lookup is ambiguous.
ticket: One complaint form about one submitted engine serial, under an OEM account with company copied at creation; actual creator is separate.
timeline: Historical application log linked by ticket ID. Ticket fields, not replayed timeline events, represent current application state.
comment: Comment linked to a ticket; actor kind may require its stored discriminator.
jir: One report per ticket according to code review, DRAFTED or PUBLISHED. Edits overwrite; this is not revision history.
foc: Form against a ticket with dealer, failure, part quantity and warranty claim information. Acronym is undefined; no documented direct JIR or replacement-approval link.
replacement_request: Ticket-linked replacement request or details. Simpson/OEM replacement modes are documented behaviour, not validated policy.
dispatch: Ticket-linked dispatch record holding the replacement serial, while the ticket holds the complaint serial. Not the physical engine master.
advance_dispatch: Advance engine sent under an OEM account. No ticket reference is documented.
advance_number: Lookup reference, not independent proof of a physical engine or ticket relationship.
work_order: Inward receipt/transport/condition record for a failed engine. Ticket association uses free-text references; no guaranteed ticket ID link.
part_replacement: Ticket-linked part line with free-text part/mode/scope/extra. Quantity is not stored here according to review.
part_description: Description-only reference. No verified mapping to Simpson part numbers in claims or FOC.
manual_claim: Entered/uploaded claim line under an OEM account. Not reconciled with SAP claim lines and not a guaranteed ticket reference.
sap_claim: Claim data imported from SAP files. OEM is text; dashboards use this collection. No validated manual-claim deduplication or ticket link.
float_stock: Individual stock engine from SAP with serial, condition, stock and amount. Serial alone does not prove identity across companies.
inventory: Count/cost summary described as calculated from float-engine stock; currency and aggregation details remain unconfirmed.
product: Model with multiple list-readiness entries. OEM and list numbers are text, without a guaranteed join to company/configuration masters.
engine_model: Active reference using the record ID as a model name; distinct from a physical engine or invoice row.
code: Active code list with COMPLAINT, DEFECT and ACTION types. Older code-list connections are not opened by the application.
bulletin: Service guidance with company/model/list/plant cut-in information. Distinction from service information needs business review; text ordering is a defect.
service_information: Same documented structure as bulletin with a different number field. No business distinction is inferred solely from schema.
cut_in: Plant/list/defect/model cut-in record. Physical serial ordering and applicability policy are not confirmed.
engine_analysis: Independent quality process per serial with named quality approval; not directly linked to tickets.
part_analysis: Independent quality process per part number. Active schema is code-reported; saved sample has no fields.
ica_capa: Independent defect-based quality record. Acronym expansion is unconfirmed; saved sample has no fields.
infant_care: Early-life engine inspection visit with entered customer/representative details, not a ticket-linked record or proof of current owner.
export_tracking: Independent export complaint tracking with text serial/codes/company references; explicit cross-connection lookups are reported by the review.
manual: Model/OEM/list/version document with archive and approval fields. Latest release is not automatically approved or effective.
manual_revision: Code-reported revision with manual reference, version, release date and approval. No fields were observed in the saved sample.
faq: Staff-editable question/answer without an approval step; not automatically verified guidance.
knowledge: Uploaded topic/document reference. Business accuracy and continued validity require review.
course: Scheduled course with model, dates and status. Requested-by account reference is code-reported but absent from current sampled fields.
booking: Booking against a course, with freely entered participants and admin acceptance/rejection. Participants are not account references.
training_material: Uploaded material; no guaranteed course/session linkage is supplied.
calendar_event: Calendar entry, separate from a scheduled course or training booking unless a reference is verified.
training_metrics: Manually entered targets and actuals. Touchpoint/man-hour definitions and formulas remain unconfirmed; domain placement is provisional.
performer: Code-reported staff record by month/year; no fields were observed in the saved sample.
engineer_movement: Staff/year attendance structure observed in metadata; detailed business interpretation is not supplied.
mis: salesCount/ticketsCount are documented as unused zero fields, not live business measures. Hardcoded chart denominators are not authoritative sales data.
sales_placeholder: No application reads/writes reported and no sampled fields. Does not establish an authoritative sales source.
